class DNASequence(Sequence):
    """DNA sequence (acme/dna.DNASequence), schema version 2."""

    IKI_TYPE = 'acme/dna.DNASequence'

    acme_dna_sequence_ptr = models.OneToOneField(

        parent_link=True,

        db_column='entity_id',
        related_name='+',
    )
    topology = models.TextField(null=True, db_default='linear')
    gc_content = QuantityField(unit='%', null=True)

    class Meta:
        db_table = 'acme__dna_dnasequence'
        constraints = [
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=Q(topology__in=['linear', 'circular']),
                name='acme__dna_dnasequence__topology__values',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=Q(gc_content__gt=float('-inf'), gc_content__lt=float('inf')),
                name='acme__dna_dnasequence__gc_content__finite',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=Q(gc_content__gte=0),
                name='acme__dna_dnasequence__gc_content__min',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=Q(gc_content__lte=100),
                name='acme__dna_dnasequence__gc_content__max',

class DNASequence_Entry(Entity):
    """Registry entries of DNA sequence (acme/dna.DNASequence), ADR 0115."""

    IKI_TYPE = 'acme/dna.DNASequence'
    IKI_ENTRY = True

    entity = models.OneToOneField(
        Entity,
        models.PROTECT,
        parent_link=True,
        primary_key=True,
        db_column='entity_id',
        related_name='+',
    )
    bases = models.TextField()
    length = QuantityField(unit='{bp}', null=True, db_index=True)

    class Meta:
        db_table = 'acme__dna_dnasequence__entry'
        constraints = [
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=GreaterThanOrEqual(Length('bases'), 1),
                name='acme__dna_dnasequence__entry__bases__not_empty',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=~Q(bases__regex='[\\r\\n]'),
                name='acme__dna_dnasequence__entry__bases__one_line',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=Q(bases__regex='^[ACGTRYSWKMBDHVNacgtryswkmbdhvn]*$'),
                name='acme__dna_dnasequence__entry__bases__format',
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=Q(length__gt=float('-inf'), length__lt=float('inf')),
                name='acme__dna_dnasequence__entry__length__finite',
            ),
        ]
